Hideaway Cottage by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Looking for coastal magnificence? Hideaway Cottage in Inlet Beach is the perfect spot. Tucked away on a private lot, this two-story cottage offers a glimpse of the Gulf from the second-floor deck and living room, just a short walk from the quiet shores of Inlet Beach. Outdoor fun starts with a fire pit, a ping pong table, and six hammocks for relaxing under the trees. Inside, the ground floor features a cozy hangout area with a TV, bean bags, a small dining table, and a half bath—great for kids to enjoy their own space. Head upstairs, and the wraparound deck becomes your go-to spot for outdoor dining and lounging. The deck features a propane grill, a dining table for six, and plenty of seating to enjoy the gulf breeze. Inside, the open layout invites you to unwind in a sunlit living room with an electric fireplace and a coffee and beverage bar.

The well-stocked kitchen has new stainless-steel appliances, ready for your beachside feasts. The main level also offers a king guest bedroom, a twin bedroom with extra-long beds, and a shared hall bathroom. The primary suite, king, includes a private ensuite for added comfort. Step outside to a shared pool area, perfect for a dip, some sun, or a peaceful break by the water. Hideaway Cottage blends comfort with style, from its inviting bedrooms to its breezy outdoor spaces. Whether it's dining at local restaurants or exploring nearby shops, Inlet Beach gives you that charming mix of Old Florida with modern touches. Come relax, unwind, and make lasting memories at Hideaway Cottage. Your beach getaway is waiting! Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths - 1657 square feet - 400 steps to beach access - Wi-Fi/Roku TV - Fire pit (wood is not provided) - 3 bikes included - Private Pool/ Shared Pool with its sister cottage (Mystic Cottage) - 2nd floor wrap-around porch with propane grill - Ping Pong Table - Dogs considered, an additional $210 nonrefundable fee for each dog Overnight: - King in 2nd floor guest bedroom; shared hall bath/shower only; smart TV - Two twin single beds in 2nd floor guest bedroom; shared hall bath/shower only; - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom; private bath with tub/shower combo; smart TV - Queen pull out sofa bed in 2nd floor living room Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
